_comment: SHARED METHODOLOGY CONTAINER - Documents data processing approach
title: OpenStreetMap Data Extraction Methodology

overview.description: This methodology describes how OSM data is extracted, processed, and integrated into the dashboard.

step_1.name: Download from HDX
step_1.description: Data is downloaded from Humanitarian Data Exchange using the HOT Export Tool exports
step_1.output: ZIP archive containing GeoJSON or Geopackage

step_2.name: Format Conversion
step_2.description: If Geopackage format, convert to GeoJSON for web compatibility

step_3.name: Regional Splitting
step_3.description: Split national dataset by 18 administrative regions using spatial intersection

step_4.name: JavaScript Wrapper
step_4.description: Create .js files with GeoJSON as JavaScript variables for direct browser loading

version_management.description: Version tracking via HDX API and local .version.json files

limitations: OSM data completeness varies by region
Rural areas may have less detailed mapping
